🛡️ Credit where due: the MoD has launched a Defence Universities Alliance — 35 institutions, £182 million, aimed at engineering, advanced manufacturing, cyber and AI. Exactly the muscles Britain let waste for thirty years.

But between a press release and a single new toolmaker sit steering groups and symposiums. Publish hard targets — headcounts and dates — and make sure the money lands in careers for British workers, not administrative overheads.
